response.sql: SELECT m.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income_amount, 1.0 * SUM(i.amount) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income), 0) AS fraction_of_all_income FROM income AS i JOIN member AS mem ON i.link_to_member = mem.member_id JOIN major AS m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.college;

assumptions.assumption: If the total amount of all income is zero or NULL, the fraction is NULL.
